meta.headline: Unifying Maison Aurèle’s customer data with AI
meta.subtitle: Data integration, BI and a forecasting model, delivered in 12 weeks.

letter.title: A partner for your data journey
paragraphs: Thank you for inviting OliveSoft to respond to your tender for a unified customer data platform. Your teams work across stores, e-commerce and CRM, and today those views do not meet.
We propose to connect them, build the dashboards your managers need and add a forecasting model, with a team that has done this for fashion and retail brands.
letter.closing: We would be glad to walk you through it.

summary.title: One customer view, forecasts you can act on

pillars.title: Unified customer view
pillars.body: Store, e-commerce and CRM data in one governed platform.

pillars.title: AI-assisted forecasting
pillars.body: Stock and demand dashboards with a model your planners can audit.

pillars.title: Low-risk delivery
pillars.body: Three phases, a working release at each, and a team matched to your stack.

summary.why_us: Why OliveSoft: delivered references in retail and fashion, certified data and Salesforce expertise, offices in Paris and Sfax.
